answer_escalation_ladder_contract.identity_rule: Every ordered step in one ladder must resolve to the same audience/question pair and to the same emitted answer card whenever the step remains on the answer side of the series.
answer_escalation_ladder_contract.import_rule: The first two steps must agree exactly with the imported publication profile, the exact-location and full-audit steps must agree exactly with the imported citation docket, and the final request-packet step must agree exactly with the imported disclosure packet.
answer_escalation_ladder_contract.monotone_reveal_rule: ordered_steps must reveal weakly more support in the fixed order default_inline -> expanded_inline -> exact_location -> full_audit -> request_packet, without changing the emitted answer identity for the same audience/question pair.
answer_escalation_ladder_contract.non_semantic_rule: Escalation ladders own only the ordered reveal policy for one already-maintained answer; they may not create new sentence text, new citation owners, or new audit routes.
answer_escalation_ladder_contract.shared_escalation_vocabulary_rule: Repeated step labels may recur in later review menus or series-spine mirrors only as imported escalation-ladder vocabulary; the concrete reveal order remains owned by the audience/question ladder.
